trigger: Arrival at the dam gate. Kessler's Remnant is in the snow outside.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: Ms. Kowalczyk. Dale Kessler. I have forty soldiers, nine hundred liters of diesel, and no orders.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: Philadelphia is gone. I checked. I'd like operational control of this facility. I'm asking. Once.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Sir. It's Ruiz. Lopez, Okafor, Tran, you know me. There's soup inside. There's no war in there.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: Major. Northland Guard. Any of mine in your ranks are released. Come in or go home.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: One soldier lowers his rifle. Then four. Then most. Kessler watches them go in, then follows, last.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: Then we do this the old way. I'm sorry. I truly am.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It lasts eleven minutes. Afterward, the snow is quiet again and there are fewer of everyone.

nodes.speaker: dell
nodes.text: Bring your diesel inside. You get a vote. One. Same as everyone.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: ...A vote. Christ. All right. I'll take a warm vote over a cold command.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Inside: the control room, 18 °C, and every faction that's left.
